verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a dedicated MCP server exposing nexus status, filings, registrations, transactions, and exemption certificates as agent-callable tools, plus a full REST API for programmatic access to tax posture and actions (calculations, transactions, certificates). This directly matches the story of an agent reading and acting on tax posture via API/MCP. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of scoped/least-privilege credential support for the MCP endpoint or API keys, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's real-world reliability.
